Total row/state counts derive from safely allocated nonzero-sized Vec/usize storage,so n+1 and label counters fit machine range under std ownership/allocation invariants.

Current actual FiniteMoore call review:nonempty reports/shape/targets admitted;normalize assigns first-appearance IDs in0..N. Refinement signature contains old block and all successor blocks,so never merges old blocks;each strict normalized change splits a block and increases block count<=N. Initial partition Vec makes last unwrap nonempty,finite strict chain terminates,each final block appears and has representative,thus count=maxID+1<=N and all representative/index operations valid. Stable relation is report-homogeneous and successor-closed,so closed-pair all-word theorem gives future equality. Conversely states with all-word equality share every refinement class by depth induction;fixed point is exactly all-word equality. Full verifier checks exact origin/every strict step/stability/map and reconstructed quotient,not merely stable arbitrary partition.

Unique None sink output prevents merger with every real state;first-state normalize sees all real states before sink indexn,so sink block is last. Stable quotient transitions are admitted and map sink to itself;real quotient_operations slice excludes exactly sink and maps dead targets toNone. This current provider behavior is independently checked by complete small product-graph distances,not self-replay alone.

Frontier invariant:root present with no parent;every queued pair is valid total state pair and known to parents. Every fresh pair stores one parent already discovered;existing keys never overwritten. Thus following parents strictly decreases finite discovery order,ends atroot,and reconstructed label chain replays root to that pair. word getter missing-key branch is unreachable at its sole private call;not a public partial certificate checker.

FIFO/shortest induction:queue contains nondecreasing first-discovery depths;successors inserted at tail with parent depth+1. A newly discovered pair has minimum possible word length;within each layer parent FIFO and ascending symbol order yield lexicographically first minimum word. Later/duplicate paths cannot improve stored predecessor. Popped first different-output pair therefore gives globally shortest input-order distinction. Parent reconstruction reverses saved edge labels once. Old queued words and new predecessor words correspond at every discovery step for every admitted finite machine,not only bounded tests.

Resource behavior preserved inductively:source real endpoint guard and zero-budget guard unchanged. Root counts1. Existing pair incurs no new charge;fresh pair first compares current parents.len with max,refuses before insert/enqueue if full. Same exact discovered pairs/input order/pop order as old algorithm means same earliest report mismatch or first resource refusal. No distinction built on an equivalent popped pair and no caller state changed on refusal. max_pairs bounds distinct pairs,not alphabet expansions,byte size,construction or quotient work.

Replay is deliberately weaker than producer minimality:it verifies the raw record own endpoints/word/saved answers and inequality,not a shortest-word theorem or external expected endpoints. Left-run error precedes right-run error;full alphabet validation applies to both. Public record tampering is refused when actual observations differ from either saved answer or are equal. A valid longer word can pass,as explicitly tested.
